page.overview:
Who is Jeaine Caide?

Jeaine had the appearance of a typical Domani, with coppery skin and a swan neck. She had dark brown eyes.

She detested men, and chose Green partly so she could beguile and control them. Yet, she was not attracted to women.

Jeane is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of the series. She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel. We can assume that all Black Ajah that took part in the Last Battle were taught the weave.

Jeaine was born in and went to the White Tower in the series. After spending six years as a novice and six years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in the series.
